page_title: CHE 2-1 BOU | Chelsea v Bournemouth 19/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+5' A rebound falls to Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) in space inside the box. He looks up and fires in a powerful shot at goal that flies just over the bar.
90+4' Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.

90+3' Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a sitter. His shot was directed into the top left corner, but the goalkeeper pulls off a marvellous diving save and denies him. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Chelsea.
90' 7 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' The corner is swung in but Bournemouth can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
89' Mauricio Pochettino decides to make a substitution. Cole Palmer will be replaced by Cesare Casadei (Chelsea).

89' Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth) produces a good strike that sails to the middle of the goal, but his effort ends up in the goalkeeper's gloves. The ball goes out of play. Bournemouth are awarded a corner kick.
84' Today's match ends for Marcos Senesi who will be replaced by Lloyd Kelly (Bournemouth).

84' Christopher Nkunku (Chelsea) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads low towards the middle of the goal, but Neto shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
82' Malo Gusto (Chelsea) hits a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box, but it's a comfortable save for Neto as it's directed low at the middle of the goal.
80' Is that a yellow card in the referee's hand? It is! Marcos Senesi (Bournemouth) gets booked.
80' Golden chance! Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) meets a cross in the box and finds some space for a shot. He produces an inaccurate effort that goes wide of the left post.

80' Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) receives a slide-rule pass inside the box and has just the keeper to beat. His shot towards the bottom left corner lacks power and Djordje Petrovic easily makes the save.
78' Malo Gusto (Chelsea) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
74' Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
74' Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
73' The resulting set piece from Bournemouth is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
72' Bournemouth have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender. The ball is out of play. Bournemouth will have a chance to score from a corner.
70' Enes Unal goes off the pitch and Philip Billing (Bournemouth) comes on.
69' Here is a change. Maximillian Aarons is going off and Andoni Iraola gives the last tactical orders to Alex Scott (Bournemouth).

68' What an opportunity! Christopher Nkunku (Chelsea) leaps high to meet a beautiful cross into the box from the free kick, and he plants a header from near the penalty spot which goes a whisker over the crossbar.
64' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Moises Caicedo walks off the pitch to be replaced by Lesley Ugochukwu (Chelsea).
64' A substitution has been made. Raheem Sterling goes off and Christopher Nkunku (Chelsea) comes on.
64' Substitution. Malo Gusto (Chelsea) has come on for Noni Madueke.
60' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Justin Kluivert leaves the pitch and Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) comes on.
59' Andoni Iraola has decided to substitute Marcus Tavernier and he is replaced by Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth).
58' Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.

57' Raheem Sterling (Chelsea) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Chelsea will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
51' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Chelsea.

51' Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. The ball goes out of play and Chelsea have been awarded a corner kick.
49' OWN GOAL! Benoit Badiashile (Chelsea) scores an unlucky own goal after he deflected a shot which went into his own net! 2:1.
48' 2 - 0 GOAL! Raheem Sterling (Chelsea) threads the eye of the needle and scores from an almost impossible angle from close in!
47' Bournemouth take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

47' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Bournemouth have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
46' The second half has just started.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+3' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) dribbles his way to the edge of the box and drills a shot towards the left side of the goal, but Djordje Petrovic is equal to the effort and makes a good save.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
44' Anthony Taylor blows his whistle and it's Raheem Sterling (Chelsea) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
43' Noni Madueke (Chelsea) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
41' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 73:27.
34' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and floats high over the bar.
30' Milos Kerkez (Bournemouth) gets booked for the first time in this match.
27' Marc Cucurella (Chelsea) is shown a yellow card by the referee.
27' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
27' The ball is cleared after Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. It will be a corner kick for Bournemouth.

24' Enes Unal (Bournemouth) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot towards the middle of the net is denied by Djordje Petrovic. This effort really didn't trouble him.
23' The corner from Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) is hurriedly cleared.
23' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked. The referee blows his whistle, Chelsea are awarded a corner kick.
22' Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
21' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears. The ball is out of play and Chelsea manage to earn a corner.
19' Bournemouth can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

17' 1 - 0 What a beautiful moment! Moises Caicedo (Chelsea) got to the ball and unleashed a strong shot from distance. It turned out to be a good decision as his effort found its way inside the right post. Neto just shakes his head in disbelief. The score changes to 1:0.
16' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
15' Noni Madueke (Chelsea) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Good work from Chelsea as they win a corner.
11' The foul by Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) was seen by Anthony Taylor who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
8' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) had a great opportunity from mid-range. His powerful volley was directed towards the middle of the goal, but Djordje Petrovic was alert and made an astonishing save!
2' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) takes a wonderful touch after collecting a pass inside the box. He steers his low drive towards the left post, but the keeper dives low to keep the ball out.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Chelsea will have the kick-off.
Anthony Taylor is the one to supervise the game today.
